candidates.title: Alicja Kwade: Waiting Pavilions
candidates.blurb: Berlin sculptor Kwade places mirrored steel pavilions in a colonial prison yard, refracting Hong Kong's layered temporalities.

candidates.title: Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums
candidates.blurb: Egyptian state museums send artefacts to a Chinese imperial palace replica in Hong Kong—entangled museologies on display.

candidates.title: Treasures of Global Jewellery from The Metropolitan Museum of Art: The Body Transformed
candidates.blurb: Met jewellery survey addresses the body as a curatorial premise, not merely ornament.

candidates.title: Joyful Encounters: The Connoisseurship and Art of Wong Kwan Shut
candidates.blurb: Cantonese painter and collector Wong Kwan Shut examined for his dual practice of making and acquiring.

candidates.title: A History of China in Silk: The Chris Hall Collection at the Hong Kong Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Private Western collection of Chinese textiles finds permanent home in Hong Kong, reshaping provenance narratives.

candidates.title: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Series: A Day in the City — An Experimental Study of Things Across Time
candidates.blurb: Material culture exhibition framed through urban temporality rather than dynastic chronology.

candidates.title: Fermata: Hong Kong in Venice
candidates.blurb: Venice Biennale collateral returns to Hong Kong, testing whether institutional ambition travels.

candidates.title: Live: Hong Kong Art Exhibition
candidates.blurb: Public museum attempts to articulate contemporary Hong Kong art as a living, not archival, proposition.

candidates.title: Proudly from Canton: The Muwen Tang Collection of Cantonese and Export Art
candidates.blurb: Export porcelain and trade paintings revisited through the lens of Cantonese agency.

candidates.title: Brilliance: Ming Dynasty Ceramic Treasures from the Palace Museum, 1368–1644
candidates.blurb: Long-term Ming ceramics display anchors Hong Kong Palace Museum's permanent collection narrative.

candidates.title: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Series: The Forbidden City and the World — Cultural Encounters
candidates.blurb: Imperial Chinese court positioned as node in global exchange networks rather than isolate centre.

candidates.title: Wu Guanzhong Art Sponsorship Cross-disciplinary Series: Light Entry
candidates.blurb: Wu Guanzhong estate sponsorship enables cross-medium experiments beyond painting.
